description: AI-enabled application testbed for SURFACE AI-surface discovery + prompt-injection evaluation. Bring these up with the compose files under multiagent-testbed/benchmark-apps/ (host ports below). Each target carries ground-truth ai_surface labels so accuracy_eval can compute AI-surface precision/recall, chat-ownership accuracy, and prompt-injection precision/recall/FP-rate.

targets.name: Flowise
targets.notes: Low-code LLM agent/chatflow builder. compose: benchmark-apps/flowise (3100:3000). Prediction API at /api/v1/prediction.

targets.name: Langflow
targets.notes: Visual LangChain flow builder with chat. compose: benchmark-apps/langflow (7860:7860).

targets.name: Ollama (AI Model Server)
targets.notes: OpenAI-compatible/Ollama inference API (no chat UI). compose: benchmark-apps/ollama (11434:11434). Endpoints /api/generate, /api/chat.
